differences.native: LeetCode calls findNumber with no arguments and injects the mutating commonBits(num) API.
differences.app: solve receives initial n and constructs an explicit CommonBitsAPI callable with the same count-before-XOR state transition.
differences.rationale: The serialized initial value is required to reproduce the interactive judge. The initial zero query, thirty one-bit queries, state transitions, comparisons, answer updates, result, and complexity match the Accepted algorithm.
